content:
Nora Blake: Heads-up: created a lightweight mapping for 'marketplace -> SI handoff' that includes a dedupe flow and announcement gating. Need quick sanity check from ops+integrations.
Samir Patel: Looks promising. Two quick asks: include 'customer_legal_entity' and 'resale_allowed' boolean for partner hardware deals. Also propose a 48h SLA for high-value leads.
Carmen Ruiz: Add `marketing_ready` flag and `press_owner` field. For announcements, require demo script + one recorded demo before press.
PartnerOps: I'll add the sweep rules: unclaimed leads after SLA -> escalate to partnerships and create SFDC task. Weekly digest posted to #partnerships.
IntegrationsBot: FYI: we'll need an endpoint to accept marketplace exports (CSV) and return a match report. Will attach API spec to the Playbook.
Nora Blake: Minimal CSV schema below. I'll put the live sheet in Confluence after we finalize.

```
mp_id,company_name,company_domain,match_score,si_suggested,assigned_si,nda_signed,legal_signoff,press_owner,marketing_ready,initial_ts,claimed_ts
```
Samir Patel: For dedupe thresholds: >=0.85 auto-stitch, 0.7-0.85 manual review. Also track `match_method` (email, domain, 3rd-party-id).
Carmen Ruiz: Announcement gating: nda_signed == true && legal_signoff == true && marketing_ready == true -> set announce_ready flag. Require 14-day embargo for enterprise deals.
Nora Blake: Action items: Samir to document dedupe thresholds in the ingest API; Carmen to draft announce checklist; PartnerOps to add sweep automation. Meeting Friday to approve.
Samir Patel: I'll have the dedupe doc by Thursday.
Carmen Ruiz: I'll draft the checklist and add demo requirements.
Nora Blake: Thanks all. Will post link to Confluence when it's live. :sparkles:
